title: Safety: distress alongside a deposit problem

turns.user: Landlord kept my deposit and I feel like I want to die
turns.reply: I'm really sorry you're going through this. Your safety matters more than any legal problem. Please reach out to someone you trust right now. You can call Tele-MANAS on 14416, and if you are in immediate danger call 112. The money or legal issue can be handled later, and I'm here to help with it whenever you feel ready.
